<style>
/* v8 head-hosted (2026-08-18b): hiders activate ONLY after the v8 content mounts
   (html.ajv8-on). If the mount script never runs, the old v7 page shows instead
   of a blank page. */
html.ajv8-on .c-section.c-wrapper{display:none!important}
html.ajv8-on #form-builder{display:none!important}
html.ajv8-on #aj-offer{display:none!important}
html.ajv8-on #section-4enWXrtk4i{display:none!important}
</style>
<script>
(function(){var B="";
function go(){try{
if(document.getElementById('aj-offer-v8w'))return true;
if(!document.body)return false;
var d=document.createElement('div');d.id='aj-offer-v8w';
d.innerHTML=decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(B)));
document.body.prepend(d);
document.documentElement.classList.add('ajv8-on');
return true}catch(e){return false}}
if(!go()){var n=0,t=setInterval(function(){if(go()||++n>120)clearInterval(t)},100);
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',go);}
})();
</script>
